goal: 共同闭合 ACP stdio/MCP 提供端与 subagent 消费者的完整请求生命周期
acceptance: Specify one source-backed provider/consumer contract before ready: identity, capabilities/version negotiation, ordered notifications, request cancellation, persisted sessions, MCP ownership and teardown.
Drive real stdio JSON-RPC initialize/new/prompt/cancel/list/resume/close/config with two Sessions, durable restoration and malformed/closed/late-result failures; no Agent=None success fallback.
MCP stdio/network transport and permission requests preserve exact Session/Agent ownership; disposable effects drain output and descendants on disconnect/unload.
Necessary ACP subagent consumers, canonical profile/launcher and extracted Portable execute the same bounded journeys; source-only ACP 139 tests do not certify Python parity.
open_findings: A1/A2/A3 permissions, controlled MCP stdio/HTTP/SSE mounting, subprocess ACP, teardown/disposal and one measured Windows descendant tree are accepted only under their bounded contracts at 5c0b3c5e. The parent has no complete source-backed contract or integrated acceptance.

Infinite blocked initialization, pathological/oversized streams, full SDK HTTP/TLS/redirect/compression/URL coverage and arbitrary supervisor/Host crash/background Job/terminal/orphan trees remain unaccepted.

Browser startup cancellation, the original fixed-40ms cache test race, Proactor warnings and HTTP 10054 remain unclassified. Complete profile journeys and deferred Win7 are separate unaccepted scopes.
next_action: 以 5c0b3c5e 已签收的有界子合同为基础，继续无限阻塞初始化、病态流、SDK HTTP/URL 与完整进程/监督树生命周期；另行制定完整父合同并执行 canonical profile/Portable 消费者闭包，不能由子任务计数推定父范围完成。
